##### Project general facts

Native Haus is a contemporary boutique low-rise development where every residence, interior detail and shared space has been thoughtfully designed to support the rhythm of everyday life, from focus and movement to stillness, connection and recovery. Designed by the acclaimed architecture practice Studio Symbiosis, the building brings together 162 residences across six storeys, complemented by a collection of exclusive retail units at ground level for everyday convenience. Homeowners can choose from stylish studios, one-bedroom apartments, one-bedroom apartments with a study and spacious two-bedroom residences with a maid's room, making it a wonderful fit for young professionals, couples and families alike.

Life at Native Haus is centred on wellbeing, with a beautiful swimming pool, a fully equipped gym and a dedicated yoga station for staying active and balanced every day. For those who work from home, the project offers an impressive indoor and outdoor co-working space where residents can focus, collaborate and meet in an inspiring setting. Evenings come alive at the open-air outdoor cinema, a delightful spot to relax and connect with neighbours under the stars.

Interiors at Native Haus are warm, refined and full of character, with generous ceiling heights and floor-to-ceiling windows that fill every home with natural light. Kitchens come fitted with premium Smeg appliances, sleek cabinetry and stylish splashbacks, creating a modern space that is both practical and elegant. Bathrooms are finished with high-quality Jaguar sanitary fittings, while the homes are delivered unfurnished, giving residents the freedom to style every room exactly to their own taste.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled in Jumeirah Village Triangle, a well-planned residential district that seamlessly blends tranquility with convenience, this exceptional location features a mix of villas, townhouses, and apartments surrounded by lush landscaping and parks. The circular layout ensures easy navigation, while ample green spaces provide a peaceful retreat for residents seeking a serene lifestyle away from the city's hustle and bustle.

The location is distinguished by its wide array of amenities catering to families and individuals. Schools, supermarkets, healthcare facilities, and fitness centers ensure all daily needs are met within a short distance. Parks, jogging tracks, and cycling paths encourage an active lifestyle, while the vibrant community center and retail outlets provide spaces for shopping and socializing. Conveniently located near major highways, the area offers excellent connectivity to Dubai's key destinations, including Dubai Marina, JBR, and Downtown Dubai.

For those seeking a residence that embodies modern living, natural surroundings, and a prime Dubai address, Jumeirah Village Triangle delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of green spaces, thoughtful infrastructure, and strategic connectivity makes it one of Dubai's most desirable destinations. This is a place where one can enjoy the perfect balance of lifestyle and location — peaceful, connected and effortlessly refined.
